entries.218cbf8617215f24: It is a trading company specializing in chemicals and healthcare, headquartered in Hirosaki City, Aomori Prefecture. The company and 2 consolidated subsidiaries make up the group, and the number of consolidated employees in the fiscal year ended September 2025 was 315. It is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market.
entries.25bf3c5452a8c827: This segment sells clinical testing reagents and related equipment. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥14,144 million. In addition to reagents for general testing, hematology testing, biochemical testing, endocrinology testing, immunoserology testing and bacteriology testing, it handles medical devices, specimen testing equipment, medical consumables and nursing care products, among others, and the company and its consolidated subsidiary Nichiei Tokai Co., Ltd. are in charge. Nichiei Tokai is a specified subsidiary that purchases clinical testing reagents from the company and sells them, and its sales account for more than 10% of consolidated revenue.

entries.5c036528dc5ebdd8: This segment sells research reagents and equipment. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥2,439 million. entries.f1323182df3694ef: It is a trading company specializing in chemicals and healthcare, headquartered in Hirosaki City, Aomori Prefecture.
entries.f627cd919af287fd: This segment sells industrial chemicals and related equipment, food products, agricultural chemicals and other items. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥17,859 million. It handles soda, industrial chemicals, organic chemicals, inorganic chemicals, semiconductor chemicals, synthetic resins, functional chemicals and insecticides for pest prevention; analytical instruments, educational equipment, measuring instruments, pollution control equipment and machine tools; food additives, food raw materials and food processing equipment; and agricultural chemicals, soil improvement materials, seeds and seedlings, horticultural supplies, fertilizers, agricultural products and cut flowers, among others, and the company and its consolidated subsidiary Asunaro Riken Co., Ltd. are in charge. Asunaro Riken mainly sells industrial chemicals to the company.
